import sys

MOD = 1000000007

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    p = int(data[0])
    k = int(data[1])
    used = [False] * p
    t = 0
    for i in range(p):
        if not used[i]:
            t += 1
            stack = [i]
            while stack:
                x = stack.pop()
                if used[x]:
                    continue
                used[x] = True
                to = (x * k) % p
                if not used[to]:
                    stack.append(to)
    exp = t - 1 + (1 if k == 1 else 0)
    ans = pow(p, exp, MOD)
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
